shotgun.label: Shotgun
shotgun.desc: Close-range spread: brutal up close, weak at range.

sniper.label: Sniper
sniper.desc: Long-range shots that hit harder the further they travel.

gunner.label: Gunner
gunner.desc: Rapid bursts of shots in a line. Reward good aim.

bouncer.label: Bouncer
bouncer.desc: Shots ricochet off walls; great around corners.

thrower.label: Thrower
thrower.desc: Lobs over walls and lands where you aim.

brawler.label: Brawler
brawler.desc: Heavy close-range punches and lots of health.

assassin.label: Assassin
assassin.desc: Dashes in to strike, then gets out.

spinner.label: Spinner
spinner.desc: Hits everything around it at once.

lasher.label: Lasher
lasher.desc: Long, narrow whips; some pull enemies in.

stream.label: Stream
stream.desc: Hold to spray a continuous cone from a refilling tank.

healer.label: Healer
healer.desc: Waves that hurt enemies and heal teammates.

boomerang.label: Boomerang
boomerang.desc: Hits on the way out and again on the way back.

chain.label: Chain
chain.desc: Zaps jump from the first enemy hit to others nearby.

zone.label: Area denial
zone.desc: Lobs clouds that keep hurting anyone standing in them.

homing.label: Orbs
homing.desc: Fans of slow orbs that cover an area (no homing).

piercer.label: Piercer
piercer.desc: Beams that go straight through every enemy in line.
